## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-fascicle glossary that serves as the lexical and historical companion to **Dìngān Déjī**'s ([德基](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BE%B7%E5%9F%BA), 1634–1700/01) sixteen-juan *Píní guānyào* ([KR6k0152](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0152)). Editorial signature: 清金陵寶華山律學沙門　德基　輯 (*Compiled by Déjī, Vinaya monk of Bǎohuáshān at Jīnlíng of the Qīng*). The work proceeds entry by entry through the names, places, dynasties, and technical terms cited in the *Guānyào* and supplies short philological and historical glosses.

**Abstract**

The *Shìyì* is a working glossary written for the early-Qīng Bǎohuáshān curriculum. The opening entries gloss the dynastic names cited at the head of *Sìfēnlǜ* translations (Yáo Qín 姚秦, Yíng Qín 嬴秦, Qǐfú Qín 乞伏秦, Fú Qín 符秦), distinguishing them historically and identifying the geographical referents (Jīnchéng 金城 = Líntáo Prefecture in Shǎnxī; Yuànchuān 苑川 = Bǎojī county in Fèngxiáng, Shǎnxī, etc.). It then proceeds to the *wǔmíng* 五明 (the five Indian sciences — *śabda*, *hetu*, *cikitsā*, *śilpa*, *adhyātma*) and the doctrinal vocabulary of the *prātimokṣa*. As a working monastic-school glossary, the *Shìyì* is invaluable for reconstructing the standard pedagogical handling of *Sìfēn* terminology in the late-seventeenth-century Vinaya school. Composition is contemporary with [KR6k0152](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0152) (between 1679 and 1700/01).
